Spicy Lemongrass Chicken
By: Anncoo
Published: Friday, April 15, 2011 - 1:29am

Ingredients




Spicy Lemongrass Paste
5 Fresh Lemongrass (use only the white part)
25 Dried red chilli (I used 30 dried chilli for more spicy)
1 1/2 inches Ginger
8 cloves of garlic
1/2 cup cooking oil (i used less oil)
Method:
Remove the outer part of lemongrass, clean and slice lemongrass, ground it coarsely together with all other ingredients into pas
Spicy Lemongrass Chicken
2 tablespoons Spicy Lemongrass Paste
1 1/2 pounds Chicken pieces/chicken breast (I used 700 g chicken wing- mid joint), marinate with some pepper and salt
1 teaspoon Meat curry powder
1 large Onion, chopped
1 tablespoon Light soy sauce/Fish sauce
1/2 teaspoon Salt
1/2 teaspoon Sugar/Palm sugar
